_comment: Per-shape schedule for the FlyDSL jagged_dense_bmm BACKWARD (grad_jagged +
Tunables: split (None -> D-derived 2 if D<=256 else 1), coarsen_m (None ->
module default 2), gj_stages_a (None -> heuristic). shape id is
reduction_k == output_n == D (square dense). Resolution: explicit kwarg >
winners exact match > fallback.by_d_bucket (D<=256 -> d_le_256, else
d_gt_256). gfx942 shape-specific gj_stages_a is =1 at D=256 and =2 at
D=512 (=1 is marginally slower there). gfx942 additionally uses split=1
for B1024,D256; it was faster for both uniform and genrec. gfx950 winners
were tuned at Mi=7680 uniform on an MI355X. split=1 wins all four deployment
shapes. After the gfx950 128x256x32 grad_jagged tile, D=256 uses
coarsen_m=1 for B=120 and 2 for B=1024. D=512 finalists retain
coarsen_m=2 and split=1. gj_stages_a is inert for the fixed two-stage tile.

gfx942.source: gj_stages_a + D=256 split A/B tuning on gfx942

gfx950.source: MI355X Mi=7680 uniform retune after the 128x256x32 grad_jagged tile
